Structs

  • MessageDelivery
    Specifies how to deliver a message to a recipient.
  • OffchainDelivery
    Off-chain delivery. Returned by MessageDelivery::offchain.
  • OnchainConstrainedDelivery
    On-chain constrained delivery. Returned by MessageDelivery::onchain_constrained.
  • OnchainDeliveryMode
    The mode of an on-chain message delivery: unconstrained or constrained tagging.
  • OnchainUnconstrainedDelivery
    On-chain unconstrained delivery. Returned by MessageDelivery::onchain_unconstrained.
  • ResolvedTaggingStrategy
    The tagging secret the PXE hands to the contract after applying the wallet's tagging secret strategy. It is already app-siloed, so the contract uses it directly to derive the message tag and never sees raw key material.

Traits

  • MessageDeliveryBuilder
    Builds the MessageDelivery configuration consumed by the message delivery APIs (e.g. NoteMessage::deliver and EventMessage::deliver). Implemented by the builder types returned from the MessageDelivery constructors.
